tasks.label: setup
tasks.command: npx next telemetry disable && npm ci

tasks.label: clear-all
tasks.command: find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -name '.next' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -name '.turbo' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && rm ./package-lock.json
tasks.detail: Clear all node_modules, .next and .turbo folders and package-lock.json
